# Tangency Foundation

> Tangency Foundation is a student-run 501(c)(3) nonprofit advancing "activism literacy" — the knowledge, skills, and critical understanding needed for effective, sustainable social change. We serve as a point of tangency between innovative ideas, grassroots movements, and vital resources, offering scholarships, micro-grants, pro-bono consulting, free training, and a large library of free organizing resources. Contact: contact@activisthq.org

Key facts:
- All consulting services are pro-bono; all resources and guides are free
- Micro-grants typically range from $250–$1,500 for US-based grassroots projects at any stage
- Supported projects can receive a Claude (Anthropic AI) membership as an in-kind resource for the duration of their project, supplied through Claude for Nonprofits
- Donations accepted via PayPal and Benevity (employer matching); 501(c)(3) status

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://activisthq.org/): Mission, featured programs, and the Activist HQ podcast
- [Activism Literacy](https://activisthq.org/literacy.html): The framework we teach — power analysis, historical context, strategic campaigning, non-violent communication
- [Our Programs](https://activisthq.org/programs.html): Scholarships, micro-grants, advocacy training, project consulting (including Claude memberships), and the podcast
- [Resources](https://activisthq.org/resources.html): Searchable library of guides, printable workbooks, action kits, and book recommendations
- [Contact](https://activisthq.org/contact.html): Get in touch about grants, consulting, partnerships
- [Participation Terms](https://activisthq.org/terms.html): Terms for scholarships, grants, in-kind resources, and services

## Guides

- [Strategic Campaign Planning](https://activisthq.org/resources/strategic-campaign-planning.html): Move from reactive protest to proactive campaigns
- [Building & Sustaining a Coalition](https://activisthq.org/resources/building-coalitions-guide.html): Build broad alliances and keep them healthy
- [Stakeholder Analysis for Impact Projects](https://activisthq.org/resources/stakeholder-analysis-guide.html): Impact/influence mapping with downloadable templates
- [SWOT Analysis for Impact Projects](https://activisthq.org/resources/swot-impact-guide.html): Mission-centered SWOT with downloadable templates
- [Digital Security for Activists](https://activisthq.org/resources/digital-security-guide.html): Threat modeling, secure communication, protest prep
- [Preventing Activist Burnout](https://activisthq.org/resources/activist-burnout-guide.html): Boundaries, collective care, sustainable organizing
- [How to Write an Op-Ed That Gets Published](https://activisthq.org/resources/writing-op-eds.html): Structure, standing, and pitching
- [Navigating Media & Press](https://activisthq.org/resources/working-with-media.html): Earning coverage and controlling your message
- [The Activist's Guide to Social Media](https://activisthq.org/resources/social-media-advocacy.html): Platform comparison for advocacy
- [10 Books for Any Activist](https://activisthq.org/resources/10-books-for-activists.html): Starting reading list with reviews
